contentList.content:
When foes take damage from your Eldritch Blast, they must succeed a Strength Saving Throw against your Potency DC or receive Glacial Destruction until the end of the turn.

If a creature dies while under this condition, its allies in combat must succeed an easy Saving Throw or take Glacial Destruction for [1] turns. When you miss with Eldritch Blast, you become Slowed until the end of the turn (unless you have Sculpt Spells).
